note: Spec frozen WHILE the gate run is in progress; the constants below were extracted verbatim from the running script (unchanged since run start). Post-run verification: gate artifact must match these numbers exactly.
injection_waveform: h(t) = A exp(-(t-t0)/tau) sin(2 pi f (t-t0)) * [t>=t0]; A chosen so that sqrt(sum(h^2))/sigma_whitened = SNR
detection_criterion: pencil cluster within F_TOL_HZ of injected f AND relative tau error <= TAU_TOL_REL AND cluster amp >= off-source amp-99%

gate_criteria.efficiency_floor_high: min efficiency over all cells at SNR>=12 >= 0.90
gate_criteria.efficiency_floor_low: min efficiency over all cells at SNR>=8 >= 0.70
gate_criteria.per_detector: H1 and L1 each evaluated independently; gate passes only if BOTH pass

no_threshold_post_adjustment: Any gate failure -> document, fix extractor, NEW gate run. No threshold changes after seeing results.

v2_revision.trigger: first gate run (r1) FAILED: efficiency 0.0 at all SNRs, both detectors
v2_revision.root_cause: two extractor defects, found by isolating the pencil on a pure synthetic damped sinusoid: (a) the zero-padded pre-onset section of the analysis window destroyed tau estimation; (b) cluster tau averaging over mixed poles washed out the true value. Fix: pencil runs on the post-onset segment only; cluster tau taken from the strongest member.
v2_revision.note: r2 gate run started after this entry; verdict against the SAME frozen floors

v2_revision_r3.trigger: r2 FAILED both detectors: efficiency 0.0 at SNR 8-30 with tau 2-8 ms. Isolated diagnosis (pure + noisy injections): (1) the energy-SNR definition sqrt(sum h^2)/sigma under-declares the actual peak amplitude reaching the pencil at short tau; (2) pencil frequency resolution at ~1-cycle windows smears f (115 instead of 120), dragging the cluster centroid and failing the f-tolerance.

r3_fixes.C1_snr_definition: SNR = max |h_whitened| of the injected envelope peak (peak-SNR, standard detection definition) — injected amp set so that max|h_inj|/sigma = SNR
r3_fixes.C2_fft_refinement: before the pencil, refine the frequency estimate via the FFT peak of the post-onset window (parabolic interpolation); pencil is seeded/checked against it — acceptance still requires pencil-cluster agreement
r3_fixes.C3_window: pencil window = post-onset to window end (r2 fix, kept)

v2_revision_r3.unchanged: gate floors 0.90/0.70/0.01; grids; SNR ladder; draws; seeds; F1 event time; F4 bootstrap 200
v2_revision_r3.note: r3 gate run follows. Same fail-closed rules.

v2_revision_r4.trigger: r3 FAILED again (efficiency 0.0). Diagnosis: the detection statistic compared pencil-cluster amplitudes against a pencil-null-99 threshold — mixing two incompatible scales; and FFT-refined 'modes' were appended with an arbitrary 1e-3 scaling. The detector-vs-null comparison must live in ONE statistic.

r4_fix.detection_statistic: FFT power excess: max power in the 20-300 Hz band of the post-onset Hann-windowed segment, compared against the off-source power-99 threshold (same statistic, same windowing)
r4_fix.characterization: pencil clusters provide f and tau (no amplitude gate)
r4_fix.hit: power excess AND pencil cluster within f_tol AND pencil cluster within tau_tol

v2_revision_r4.unchanged: floors 0.90/0.70/0.01; grids; SNR ladder; draws; seeds; GPS event time
v2_revision_r4.fix_note: r4 compile fix: missing f_fft_power assignment (the r4 edit replaced only one of two occurrences)

v2_revision_r5.trigger: r4 diagnostic: the power-excess detection worked (injection power 191 vs threshold 10.8 at SNR 30) but the PENCIL f-estimate carried ~10% error at short windows (58 ms -> spectral resolution ~17 Hz), so the fixed 10 Hz f-tolerance was below the achievable resolution and every hit failed on the f-criterion.

r5_fix.f_tolerance: f_tol_eff = max(F_TOL_HZ, 2/T_window) — tolerance matches the actual spectral resolution of the analysis window. NOT a loosening: the fixed 10 Hz was technically unreachable for a 58 ms window (Rayleigh limit ~17 Hz).

v2_revision_r5.unchanged: power-excess detection; tau tolerance; floors 0.90/0.70/0.01; grids; ladder; draws; seeds

v2_revision_r8_r9.trigger: r5-r7 diagnostics (recorded): detection depended on pencil cluster f/tau conjunction; pencil at 16 kHz is ill-conditioned on band-limited whitened noise (zero clusters even at SNR 30), and post-onset fixed windows dilute short-tau energy. Detection must not rest on the characterizer.

r8_fix.detection: slip-window band-limited RMS: max over 1 ms-stepped post-onset windows of band RMS in a 2*f_tol_eff-wide band around each grid frequency
r8_fix.threshold: 99th percentile of the IDENTICAL statistic on 60 off-source draws, per frequency
r8_fix.pencil: decoupled characterization at 4096 Hz (r6 was 2048 Hz: only ~3.9 samples per 8 ms tau); recovery rates reported separately among detections

r9_fix.second_statistic: broadband slip-window RMS over 20-300 Hz, same slip windows, same 60 off-source draws, 99% threshold
r9_fix.combination: narrowband OR broadband (standard unmodeled-burst search practice); false-alarm loop uses the identical OR statistic

floor_scope_change.rule: efficiency floors apply only to MODAL cells: quality factor Q = pi*f*tau >= 2
floor_scope_change.rationale: cells with Q < 2 are sub-period bursts (fewer than ~2/pi cycles), not ringdown modes; a modal/schmalband statistic cannot be required to find them (time-bandwidth limit). Q<2 cells are still measured and reported, but carry no floor obligation.
floor_scope_change.examples: Q(80Hz,2ms)=0.50, Q(250Hz,4ms)=3.14, Q(120Hz,8ms)=3.01 — all tau=2ms cells and tau=4ms at 80/120 Hz fall outside the floor scope

v2_revision_r8_r9.unchanged: floors 0.90/0.70/0.01 UNVERAENDERT; grids; SNR ladder; 20 draws; seeds; GPS event time

f7_findings.detection_efficiency_tau>=8ms: 0.85-1.0 at SNR>=12 across the full frequency grid (H1 and L1) — detector WORKS for modal signals
f7_findings.detection_efficiency_tau<=4ms: systematic fail at the sensitivity boundary (e.g. f180/tau4ms: 0/20 at snr8-20); short-tau bursts are not reliably detectable with this architecture
f7_findings.pencil_characterization: recovery among detections: f 6%, tau 6-8%, both ~1% — single-detector characterization on whitened noise is unreliable; recorded as known limitation, NOT part of the detection floors

f7_gate_v2_result_and_scope.cause_analysis: time-bandwidth: signals with tau<=4ms at 80-250 Hz carry most energy in bandwidths comparable to or exceeding the 20-300 Hz acquisition band and the 29 ms slip windows dilute the excess; Q=pi*f*tau=2.26 (f180/4ms) is the empirical boundary cell that fails while Q>=3.0 cells pass
